description:
Kwon Ji-Hyeok, a good-for-nothing who’s lived his whole life relying solely on the handsome face he inherited from his parents, finds himself kicked out of his girlfriend’s house with nowhere else to go. While wandering in search of his next place to freeload, he stumbles upon a mansion with its door left open and decides to sneak in. But inside, he’s greeted by the horrifying sight of a dismembered corpse. Sensing imminent doom, he tries to escape, only for the missing homeowner to appear right then and there. One look is all it takes for Ji-Hyeok to realize it: this guy definitely has the face of a serial killer. 

For someone who’s always coasted through life on his looks, this is the biggest crisis he’s ever faced. To survive, Ji-Hyeok might have to pull his most desperate move yet, using his charm to seduce this psychopathic killer. Because if he fails, it won’t just be his pride that gets pierced.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*
